findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-501.110: The dish machine is observed still out of order during today’s inspection. PIC stated maintenance has started repairs and are waiting on parts. An additional follow-up will take place on 2/20/2024 to retest the dish machine. Inspector will contact the PIC at (217)525-3261 the morning of 2/20/2024 to inquire about the repairs. If at that time no repairs have been made, the re-inspection will be moved accordingly. Facility is utilizing their triple sink as a temporary alternative.
4-501.110: (A) Temperature of the wash solution in spray type warewashers using hot water may not be less than: 165F for stationary rack-single temperature, 150F for stationary rack-dual temperature machine, 160F single tank, conveyor-dual temperature, 150F multitank conveyor-multitemperature. (B) Temperature for wash solution using chemical SANITIZER may not be less than 120F.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-501.110: The dish machine was ran multiple times and tested with a temperature measuring disc and heat test strips. The dish machine was recorded at 145 degrees F for three straight cycles. The temperature at the plate surface must reach at least 160 degrees F for proper sanitizing to occur. A service order has been ordered for the machine. A follow-up has been issued for February 9, 2024 to retest the dish machine as being operational to standards. While the machine is down, facility is utilizing their triple sink as a temporary solution for the wash, rinse, sanitize cycle. Ensure the machine is tested daily or at a frequency necessary to maintain it in operational order. 
4-501.110: (A) Temperature of the wash solution in spray type warewashers using hot water may not be less than: 165F for stationary rack-single temperature, 150F for stationary rack-dual temperature machine, 160F single tank, conveyor-dual temperature, 150F multitank conveyor-multitemperature. (B) Temperature for wash solution using chemical SANITIZER may not be less than 120F.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The dish machine was observed to be leaking water during its cycle. It was observed the water was leaking from the seal of the corner piece where a gap is present with visible build-up. Ensure these gaps are sealed to prevent water from leaking out of the dish washer during the cycle. PIC has received email confirmation during the inspection that a work order has been placed.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The electrical wire of the standing hot holding unit is observed to have an accumulation of dust/soil residues. Ensure this surface is cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain the free of dust/soil.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: Thee is observed soil underneath the triple door cooler. This area needs to have attention given to it in order to clean the soils. Ensure regular cleaning is performed under the equipment to maintain the surfaces free of soil.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The sink with he sprayer next to the dish machine is observed to have a pipe coming through the metal. The gaps around the pipe need to be sealed with caulking or another substance that creates a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surfaces. Ensure this repair is made to prevent accumulation of soil reside in the gaps.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: No test kit for quat sanitizer available to check the sanitizer concentration. 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. Provide and use test kit for sanitizer.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: The fan blowing across the dish drying area has some dust accumulation. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. Properly clean fan and maintain clean so that it does not contaminate clean dishes.
